Unakku oru letter 💌

Kuttymah ❤️

Innaiku un birthday nu sonna mattum pothaadhu… enakku romba special-aana oru naal. En life-la nee vandhadhukku apram, sila ordinary moments kooda beautiful memories-aa maariduchu.

Un smile, un eyes, un chinna chinna kovam, un care… ellame enakku romba precious. Namma rendu perum perfect illa… but namma memories mattum enakku perfect-a irukku.

Sometimes words-la solla mudiyadha alavukku nee enakku important. Happy-a irundhaalum, tough-a irundhaalum, life-la enna nadandhaalum, unakku nalla things mattum nadakkanum-nu naan heart-la wish panren.

Indha birthday unakku oru beautiful new chapter start aaganum. Nee dream panra ellame konjam konjam-aa un life-la nadakkanum. And most importantly… nee eppovume un smile-a lose pannama irukkanum.

Happy Birthday, Kuttymah! 🎂❤️
Unakku romba special-aana oruthan,
Darling ❤️
— Darling ❤️
